title: Skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='deck' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7acc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d63a9e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='w' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow glow under board -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#3a2a55' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- deck -->
  <path d='M10 44 Q10 32 24 32 L76 32 Q90 32 90 44 Q90 56 76 56 L24 56 Q10 56 10 44 Z' fill='url(#deck)'/>
  <!-- deck top highlight -->
  <path d='M16 39 Q16 36 26 36 L74 36 Q84 36 84 39 Q84 43 74 43 L26 43 Q16 43 16 39 Z' fill='#ffb3e0' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- grip tape stripe accents -->
  <rect x='26' y='46' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a1f66'/>
  <rect x='40' y='46' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a1f66'/>
  <rect x='54' y='46' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a1f66'/>
  <rect x='68' y='46' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a1f66'/>

  <!-- trucks -->
  <rect x='24' y='56' width='16' height='8' rx='3' fill='#9aa7c7'/>
  <rect x='60' y='56' width='16' height='8' rx='3' fill='#9aa7c7'/>
  <rect x='22' y='58' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9d4ec'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='67' r='9' fill='url(#w)'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='67' r='3.5' fill='#7a5b00'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='67' r='9' fill='url(#w)'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='67' r='3.5' fill='#7a5b00'/>
  <!-- wheel shine -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='64' r='2.2' fill='#fff6c4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='64' r='2.2' fill='#fff6c4' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- wheels behind trucks hint -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='65' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#e0a000' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='65' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#e0a000' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
